source:
建议标签来自用户关注名单或历史公开报告，不是当前文件的病毒鉴定。请自行核对来源、版本及是否仍需使用，由你决定是否卸载。

卸载可能永久移除文件、设置或关联功能，影响其他软件，要求重启，并可能保留残留文件。请先保存工作并备份重要数据。Process Keeper 不能保证厂商卸载器完整或安全地完成操作。

本次只逐个运行已注册的普通卸载器，需要你完成软件自身的页面。不会强删文件、注册表或驱动。结果无法确认时停止后续项目；停止等待或关闭本应用不会终止已经启动的卸载器。

即使处于无视风险模式，这三次确认也不会跳过。确认即表示你已阅读以上说明，并自主决定继续。
en:
Suggested labels reflect the user's watchlist or historical public reports, not a virus verdict on the current files. Check the origin, version and whether you still need each application. You decide whether to uninstall.

Uninstalling may permanently remove files, settings or related features, affect other software, require a restart and leave remnants. Save your work and back up important data first. Process Keeper cannot guarantee that vendor uninstallers finish completely or safely.

Only registered normal uninstallers run, one at a time. Complete each application's own window. No files, registry entries or drivers are forcibly deleted. Unconfirmed results stop later entries. Stopping observation or closing this app does not terminate an uninstaller that has already started.

These three confirmations remain mandatory even in Ignore risks mode. Confirming means you have read this notice and choose to continue.
